protocol.ExampleSwitch.warning: Visible only in technical details; not intended for everyday use.
protocol.IthoRFT.instruction: Repeatedly press one speed or timer button on your Itho remote.
protocol.IthoRFT.ha_result: Confirmed speed/timer events and supported measurements where available.
protocol.IthoRFT.warning: RFLink transmits with its own virtual Itho remote. Pair it with the ventilation unit once before using control.
protocol.Acurite609TXC.instruction: Wait until the same sensor message has been received several times.
protocol.Acurite609TXC.ha_result: Confirmed temperature, humidity and battery warning where available.
protocol.Acurite609TXC.warning: After a battery change the RF identity may change; do not link a new identity automatically.
protocol.FineOffsetWH2.instruction: Wait for several messages from the weather sensor.
protocol.FineOffsetWH2.warning: A missing measurement does not mean that feature should be removed.
protocol.Nexa.instruction: Press On several times and then Off on the same channel.
protocol.Nexa.ha_result: Confirmed On/Off events. Control buttons appear only after separate transmit permission.
protocol.Nexa.warning: A remote and the lamp are not automatically the same device; learn multiple channels separately.
protocol.ByronSX.instruction: Press the doorbell button several times and wait until RFLink recognizes the same signal.
protocol.ByronSX.ha_result: A bell event; a transmit button only after separate permission.
protocol.ByronSX.warning: A transmit command does not confirm that the bell actually rang.
protocol.Dooya.instruction: Press the same button repeatedly. Learn other buttons separately afterwards as feature proposals.
protocol.Dooya.ha_result: Approved button events; transmit buttons only after separate permission.
protocol.Dooya.warning: Button numbers do not yet define meanings such as Up or Stop. Do not assign them automatically.
protocol.KeeLoq.instruction: Press the same button several times and check that the same remote is recognized.
protocol.KeeLoq.ha_result: Received button events and battery warning when decoded.
protocol.KeeLoq.warning: Rolling code is protected; received messages must not be retransmitted.
protocol.RCSwitch.instruction: Press one button several times. Learn another fixed code separately and link it yourself to the desired device.
protocol.RCSwitch.ha_result: One event for the recognized code; optionally a transmit button after permission.
protocol.RCSwitch.warning: Code, protocol and bit length must match. On and off codes are not linked automatically.
protocol.AlectoV1.instruction: Wait for several transmissions from the weather sensor; do not press random buttons.
protocol.AlectoV1.ha_result: Only measurements you confirm, such as temperature, humidity and possibly rainfall.
protocol.AlectoV1.warning: Not every variant transmits all measurements. A missing value is not automatically a fault.
protocol.SomfyRTS56.instruction: Repeatedly press the same button on your Somfy remote. Do not use the programming button for this receive test.
protocol.SomfyRTS56.ha_result: Received actions can be monitored. After pairing RFLink, approved Up, Down and My controls can also be used.
protocol.SomfyRTS56.warning: Transmit uses a separate virtual RFLink remote with its own rolling counter. Pair RFLink with the motor before normal control; physical motor validation is still pending.
protocol.RubicsonTemp.instruction: Wait for several messages from the temperature sensor.
protocol.RubicsonTemp.ha_result: Confirmed temperature and battery warning where available.
protocol.RubicsonTemp.warning: Channel and checksum are technical data and not separate Home Assistant sensors.
decoder.select_hint: Select a decoder to view all information.
decoder.reason_sensor: This protocol is a receive-only sensor. Transmit is intentionally disabled.
decoder.reason_example: This is a development example, not a live RF protocol.
decoder.reason_tx_ready: A reviewed transmitter encoder is available for this protocol.
decoder.reason_tx_host: The transmitter encoder exists and passes software tests, but has not yet been verified with real RF hardware.
decoder.reason_itho: Receive and native packet transmit are integrated. RFLink uses a separate virtual transmitter identity per learned Itho device.
decoder.reason_somfy: Receive and transmit are implemented. RFLink controls Somfy as a separate virtual remote with its own rolling counter.
decoder.reason_keeloq: Receive can identify supported frames, but generic transmit is blocked by KeeLoq rolling-code encryption.
decoder.reason_no_encoder: Receive support exists, but no reviewed transmitter encoder is registered.
decoder.needed_none: Nothing; receive-only is the intended behavior.
decoder.needed_hw_test: A real-device RF test and capture comparison before marking transmit hardware-verified.
decoder.needed_itho: Pair RFLink once with the ventilation unit, then validate the controls on real hardware.
decoder.needed_somfy: Pair the RFLink virtual remote with the motor. Physical motor validation is still pending.
decoder.needed_keeloq: A supported product plus its valid cryptographic key/pairing method. This cannot be derived safely from normal RF captures alone.
decoder.needed_encoder: A protocol-specific transmit encoder plus software and hardware validation.

help.id_more: RFLink uses it together with versions and content fingerprints to detect duplicates, updates and local modifications.
